protocol.aggregation: Within patient first; equal patient macro mean and sample SD
protocol.reference: Paired Z256 OCTA; raw normalized intensities; no contrast stretch
protocol.bscan: volume[:, y, :] => 304 ZX slices per patient; no resize
protocol.projection: FULL Z-mean; ILM_OPL and OPL_BM annotated layer maxima; inherited frozen projection protocol
protocol.vessels: ILM_OPL only; GT_LargeVessel OR GT_Capillary >0; BMP orientation unchanged [X,Y]
protocol.weighted: Multiply BOTH images by weight1 on annotation,0.1 elsewhere; data_range stays1
protocol.density: Each image independently thresholded strictly above its global mean; VDE absolute occupancy difference; VDC Pearson over nonoverlapping16x16 occupancy patches
protocol.topology: Hard2D skeletonize Zhang clDice + Dice/IoU; threshold-derived prediction vs official annotation; NOT a learned vessel segmenter or3D topology result
protocol.empty_masks: Both empty Dice/IoU/clDice=1; only one empty=0; undefined Pearson=null
protocol.lpips: AlexNet pretrained ImageNet + LPIPS v0.1 learned weights; grayscale replicatedRGB;[0,1] to[-1,1]; no resize; eval FP32
